hypothesis: A frozen H3-conditioned or FACT-consequence critic ranks successful first-action chunks above failed alternatives in unseen source episodes beyond an action-only shortcut.
single_variable: The critic representation is action-only, frozen-H3 state-action interaction, or frozen FACT future-H3 consequence; C25 data, parent policy, pairwise objective and budget remain fixed.
parent_baseline: C25 D0-H32-s14000 causal first-action dataset: 128 branches, 32 fixed states, 6 train mixed groups/21 pairs and 3 untouched validation mixed groups/9 pairs.

references.title: FACT: A Failure-Aware Causal Transformer for World Action Models

architecture.upstream_code: Generated action conditions predicted future and value used for best-of-N.
architecture.local: Frozen D0/H3 plus an isolated pairwise linear head; one arm reuses the frozen passed future-H3 expert.
architecture.rationale: Only 21 training pairs prohibit a full FACT reproduction.

data.local: Four alternative first actions per bit-exact restored state; continuations use identical seed schedules; source episodes are split-disjoint.
data.rationale: The local target is directly observed closed-loop success.

action.upstream_code: Candidate action is scored before selection.
action.local: The exact 32-step environment-domain chunk that was executed; converted back to dataset normalization for the frozen FACT expert.
action.rationale: Scoring the decoded executed action avoids pre-clamp deployment mismatch.

objective.local: Within-state pairwise logistic success ordering only.
objective.rationale: Pairwise ordering is identifiable while global calibration is not.

optimization.local: 1000 full-pair steps; 42 balanced pair examples per epoch; 42000 examples seen; all parents frozen.
optimization.rationale: This is a bounded falsifiable critic canary.

evaluation.local: Three untouched source episodes, nine within-state success/failure pairs, action-only and shuffled-label controls, exact label permutation p-value.
evaluation.rationale: Closed loop remains gated on ranking.
